AdvanceRequest.description:
Contract v1.9 (Q4): the run's use. Required for a run stored without one, which then
keeps it; refused with 409 when it differs from the run's.
AdvanceRequest.title: AdvanceRequest

AgentTool.description: The orchestrator tools in PROJECT.md §5, plus `answer` for a specialist's answer step.
AgentTool.title: AgentTool

CalculationsReattached.description:
Contract v1.11 (review plan Q5): a stored run's calculation cards re-attached under a
changed rule, by code and at $0. The screen's text is built from these fields; none is
stored as prose. A new type under the v1.9 stamp: adding a member changes no other model.
CalculationsReattached.title: CalculationsReattached

CapHitRefused.description: The gateway refused a call: the run stops with this status.
CapHitRefused.title: CapHitRefused

CapHitReserve.description: The analysis stops at the severity reserve (R38); severity runs next.
CapHitReserve.title: CapHitReserve

ChainsFinishedNoScenarios.description: No scenario line fitted, so the connector was not called.
ChainsFinishedNoScenarios.title: ChainsFinishedNoScenarios

DemoResponse.description: The site's default run (the picker's first) in full, and every run the picker offers.
DemoResponse.title: DemoResponse

DemoRun.description:
A run the site's plant picker offers (contract v1.11, review plan R0): its banner as
Bhargavi wrote it, with the start line's served rank filled in, and that line. A banner
that names a line not on the shortlist is left out.
DemoRun.title: DemoRun

DispatchNoRoom.description: Not even the first batch fits the spend left: the analysis ends.
DispatchNoRoom.title: DispatchNoRoom

DispatchNothingToSend.description: Every chosen question was already answered: stored results are used.
DispatchNothingToSend.title: DispatchNothingToSend

ErrorBody.description: 401, 403, 404, 409 and 501 bodies. `phase` names the phase that will build a 501 route.
ErrorBody.title: ErrorBody

Hypothesis.description:
One hypothesis of the whole-plant pass (R50), as validated. Immutable: its question
links are set when it is created; whether findings support it is computed when read.
Hypothesis.title: Hypothesis

InvalidEvent.description:
An event a live run wrote although its payload failed its model (Bhargavi,
2026-10-23): shown with its flag and the error, its payload as written.
InvalidEvent.title: InvalidEvent

Issue.description: A plant validation error or warning (schema/validate.py), naming the offending ID.
Issue.title: Issue

MechanismClass.description:
The class of mechanism a hypothesis describes (Phase 9 spec 9.1, 9.4): the classes the
accident-data priors name, plus `other`.
MechanismClass.title: MechanismClass

ModelCall.description: Stored per (run_id, id): a cached response reused by another run is a second record.
ModelCall.title: ModelCall

ModifierNotApplied.description: A modifier kind of modifiers.csv the record did not apply, and why (P3-3).
ModifierNotApplied.title: ModifierNotApplied

OperatingMode.description:
The plant's state a hypothesis assumes (Phase 9 spec 9.1); accident records cluster in
the non-normal ones.
OperatingMode.title: OperatingMode

PhaseBudget.description: Contract v1.9 (G6): the phase API runs book to, and what is left of its cap.
PhaseBudget.title: PhaseBudget

QuestionStatus.description: `answered` and `not_credible` count as checked. Unsure is a confidence, not a status.
QuestionStatus.title: QuestionStatus

RejectedSuggestion.description: A Super suggestion that code refused, with code's reason (contract v1.3, R23).
RejectedSuggestion.title: RejectedSuggestion

RunExtendedPass.description: A new post-analysis pass, or a resume after the post cap.
RunExtendedPass.title: RunExtendedPass

RunStatus.description: `draft` = run created, setup not yet done (D9).
RunStatus.title: RunStatus

SectionSuggestion.description: A Super suggestion on the rule-drawn cut, always with its reason.
SectionSuggestion.title: SectionSuggestion

SectionType.description:
Applicability key: the equipment types, plus pipe and procedure.

Planned-work sections have no section type; they get only work: questions.
SectionType.title: SectionType

SeverityClassInfo.description: A severity class as `reference/severity_classes.csv` defines it (contract v1.11).
SeverityClassInfo.title: SeverityClassInfo

ShortlistEvidence.description:
An evidence record as a shortlist line shows it. Contract v1.11 (review plan Q6): what
the card is attached through, the line's findings or facts that brought it, computed by
the attachment rule when the list is read and never stored.
ShortlistEvidence.title: ShortlistEvidence

ShortlistTier.description:
The three tiers of the final list (R50): hypotheses the checks support, the other
scenarios the pipeline found, and hypotheses no check supported.
ShortlistTier.title: ShortlistTier

StepFinishedBare.description: A step with no summary: every step that only moves on, and any step stopped by a cap.
StepFinishedBare.title: StepFinishedBare

SupersededRecord.description:
A post-analysis record a re-run replaced (contract v1.7): copied here verbatim, never
changed or deleted. `pass_seq` is the `seq` of the `run_extended` event that began the
pass it belonged to; `superseded_seq` that of the event that replaced it. Contract v1.8
adds the evidence pass: its records, agent steps and their tool calls.
SupersededRecord.title: SupersededRecord

Tier.description: Model tiers; config/routing.yaml maps jobs to these, the live model list to IDs.
Tier.title: Tier

UseBudget.description:
Contract v1.9 (C6): one use of this environment, from its own ledger, read the way the
gateway checks it.
UseBudget.title: UseBudget

WorksheetRow.description: One worksheet row; the columns are the Excel export's (PROJECT.md §5 Step 8).
WorksheetRow.title: WorksheetRow

info.description: AI HAZOP preparation. Every run-related response carries a label (live, recorded or mock). Without mock mode, endpoints return 501 until their phase.
info.title: Guideword API
